notes: The post is tagged Dark but the author says it is a Light Side deck listed in the wrong section; it is treated as Light.
The description calls it a deck for an Episode I format (cards are Episode I-era only).
Starting cards as posted under 'starting 3': Tatooine: Slave Quarters ('slave hut'), Mindful Of The Future ('mindful of'), Brisky Morning Munchen; they count toward the 60. No objective.
Posted 'molestare' (one of four 'places') matches no card and is kept as written; it may be Tatooine: Mos Espa, whose game text moves characters from Slave Quarters.
The final 'yet another red 1' line is posted only as 'starting effect card'; kept as written (counted).
Episode I deck, so the Coruscant-set printings are used for Coruscant, Tatooine, Sense ('sence'), Alter and Control.
Posted 'r3 quigon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn, Jedi Master; 'coruscant quigon' dested Master Qui-Gon; 'tatooine quigon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'yaura' dested Yarua; 'shimi' dested Shmi Skywalker.

Posted 'jarjars stick' dested Jar Jar's Electropole; 'quigons stick (r3)' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber; 'obiwans stick' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Reflections III), which deploys on Episode I Obi-Wan; 'naboo fighter' dested Naboo Defense Fighter; 'republican cruiser' dested Republic Cruiser.
Mindful Of The Future is posted once in the starting section and x4 under 'reds' (5 total, as published).
